data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 城堡冬夜
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 伊莉雅 · 城堡冬夜】二十岁以上成年后的伊莉雅独坐在城堡书房的熊皮地毯上，红色毛皮大衣从成熟肩颈滑落并敞开胸前。她屈起一条修长腿靠近壁炉，一手抓住厚实衣领，另一手探入大衣下摆，银发与红瞳被火光染暖——「已经不是需要别人哄睡的年纪了……今晚的温度，由我自己决定。」
data.action: 红冬大衣半褪坐在壁炉前
data.lighting: warm roaring fireplace and snowy window moonbeams
data.promptProse: Illyasviel warms one foot by the hearth while holding her slipped coat collar, her other hand beneath its hem. Warm firelight meets cold moonbeams from the snowy window on the fur rug.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the coat collar while the other stays beneath its hem.
